Discoverer II.fact: Discoverer II (initially called STARLITE) was a joint DARPA, Air Force, and National Reconnaissance Office project to build and launch a low Earth orbit (LEO) constellation for space-based radar.

Discoverer II.question: The project began in _____ but was canceled by Congress in 2000
Discoverer II.fact: The project began in 1998 but was canceled by Congress in 2000.
